items.title: Asymmetric impacts and legacy effects of dry–wet abrupt alternation on global terrestrial vegetation productivity
items.title_en: Asymmetric impacts and legacy effects of dry–wet abrupt alternation on global terrestrial vegetation productivity
items.title_zh: 干湿骤变对全球陆地植被生产力的非对称影响及其遗留效应
items.summary_en: Global warming increases the frequency of compound climatic extremes such as dry–wet abrupt alternation (DWAA), which can affect terrestrial ecosystem productivity. However, the asymmetric impacts and legacy effects of DWAA on global vegetation productivity have not been systematically assessed. Using the Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI), the Standardized Precipitation Index, and three gross primary productivity (GPP) products, we identified monthly DWAA events, including dry-to-wet (DW) and wet-to-dry (WD) transitions, and assessed their global productivity impacts and subsequent dynamics. Our results show that DWAA caused spatially heterogeneous GPP losses that varied with transition direction. DW generally caused greater initial GPP losses, whereas the effects of WD were more persistent. DW loss exceeded WD loss in four of the six main comparisons of GPP products and indices. This predominant magnitude asymmetry persisted across most alternative event definitions but weakened at longer accumulation scales. Among vegetation groups, grasslands most frequently experienced the largest loss during the transition month. GPP generally recovered earlier following DW than following WD, although recovery timing varied among products. GPP responses during the period following events also differed between the two transition directions. DW was associated with greater sensitivity to soil moisture and more negative responses to radiation and temperature. In contrast, the slopes relating GPP to precipitation following WD were consistently lower than those during normal months, whereas responses to the other environmental conditions varied among products and indices. These findings reveal that the effects of compound dry and wet extremes vary with transition direction and hydroclimatic context, highlighting the need to represent this asymmetry in assessments of ecosystem resilience and carbon cycle responses to climate change.
items.summary_zh: 全球变暖加剧了干湿骤变（DWAA）等复合型极端气候事件的发生频率，这些事件可能影响陆地生态系统的生产力。然而，DWAA对全球植被生产力的非对称影响及其遗留效应尚未得到系统评估。通过使用标准化降水蒸散量指数（SPEI）、 标准化降水指数以及三种总初级生产力（GPP）数据产品，我们识别出了月度DWAA事件（包括干转湿（DW）和湿转干（WD）过渡），并评估了其对全球生产力的影响及后续动态。 研究结果表明，DWAA导致了空间上不均匀的GPP损失，且损失程度随过渡方向而变化。DW通常导致更大的初期GPP损失，而WD的影响则更为持久。 在六项主要GPP产品和指数的对比中，有四项显示DW造成的损失超过WD。这种显著的幅度不对称性在大多数替代事件定义中均存在，但在更长的累积时间尺度上有所减弱。在各类植被群落中，草原在过渡月期间最常出现最大幅度的损失。总体而言，DW后的GPP恢复时间早于WD后，尽管不同产品间的恢复时间存在差异。 事件发生后的GPP响应在两种过渡方向之间也存在差异。干旱（DW）与对土壤湿度的更高敏感性以及对辐射和温度的更负面响应相关。相比之下，湿润事件（WD）后GPP与降水相关的斜率始终低于正常月份，而对其他环境条件的响应则因产品和指标而异。 这些发现表明，干湿极端事件叠加的影响会随过渡方向和水文气候背景而变化，这凸显了在评估生态系统韧性及碳循环对气候变化的响应时，有必要体现这种不对称性。

items.title: Introducing Berkeley Earth’s Data Pipeline 2.0
items.title_en: Introducing Berkeley Earth’s Data Pipeline 2.0
items.title_zh: 介绍伯克利地球（Berkeley Earth）的数据管道 2.0
items.summary_en: A rebuilt, expanded and more resilient foundation for the Berkeley Earth temperature record. For fifteen years stakeholders from across the climate, resilience, and research ecosystems have come to Berkeley Earth for a clear, transparent, and trustworthy read on how our climate is changing. Much of that trust rests on work that has, until very recently, remained relatively invisible: the data pipeline that gathers, merges, and quality-checks millions of observations from more than 50,000 global weather stations every month. Following a number of upstream data disruptions last year, Berkeley Earth made a commitment to invest in building a more resilient and robust data pipeline, one less dependent on any one single upstream source of observations, and one that could maintain crucial data continuity in the case that any single ingest product was disrupted or lost. Today we’re excited to announce the launch of Berkeley Earth’s newly rebuilt pipeline 2.0, not only reinforced but expanded to provide not only the most comprehensive but also the most resilient observational temperature record available. Below is an overview of what we improved, what hasn’t changed, and why this matters for the greater climate and resilience ecosystem. What’s New Nearly 3x more data ingest sources and 15,000 new weather stations. We’ve substantially expanded the number of independent ingest sources feeding our analysis, building in redundancy and resilience into the foundational layer of our pipeline. Observations straight from the national agencies. Rather than waiting for observations to reach us through a single intermediary, we now pull observations directly from the national weather agency itself, including: Météo-France, Germany’s Deutscher Wetterdienst, the UK Met Office, Environment and Climate Change Canada, Australia’s Bureau of Meteorology, the Japan Meteorological Agency, and Brazil’s INMET, with more on the way. Additional international observational collections were added, both current and historic, including: the WMO’s WIS2, Southern Africa’s SASSCAL, the DWD CLIMAT monthly summary, and the HARD historic arctic archive. Pulling directly from these collections significantly expands our coverage across the African continent, adds texture to our historic arctic archive, and adds significant redundancy to our existing data sources, ensuring additional pipeline resilience. Faster, and more resilient. Going straight to the source gets measurements into our hands sooner and builds real redundancy into the system. Our data pipeline is no longer dependent on any one source or intermediary for raw observations, leaving us in a far more resilient and robust position. More depth in high-demand markets. Thousands of new additional stations across grid cells new to our analysis strengthen an already world-leading network in the regions our work is used most, including the UK, France, and Germany. Full expanded station archive available on Synthesis. The full library of Berkeley Earth’s station data archive, including the newly added stations, is currently available via Berkeley Earth’s climate risk platform Synthesis. In the coming weeks and months we’ll be working to build near-real-time updates to the data availability on Synthesis, and we’ll update you once that’s available. What Hasn’t Changed The warming trend remains unchanged – Many of the additional stations new to our analysis sit in regions that were already well monitored, so the fundamental historic trend remains unchanged…which is consistent with our expectations. What these additional stations do is create crucial redundancy in the case that a portion of reporting stations is lost, and ensures we’re able to continue delivering our climate monitoring program to our users and clients – no matter what happens upstream. Our methodology does not change – the upgrades to our data ingest pipeline described above sit upstream to the trusted bias correction and downscaling methodologies that define the Berkeley Earth Surface Temperature and BEST-HR high-resolution data products; our fundamental methodology remains unchanged following these upgrades. What’s Next The rebuilt pipeline is faster by design, which means earlier monthly updates going forward, and we expect to have near-real-time data flowing into Synthesis, our high-resolution climate platform, available within the next few months. NOW AVAILABLE ON SYNTHESIS Our complete station archive Along with this rebuild, Berkeley Earth’s full station archive is now open on Synthesis, made available for researchers, analysts, and anyone who wants to get their hands on the data behind the record. A few key stats about our world-leading station data archive: Around 1.6 billion observations from tens of thousands of stations worldwide — one of the most complete land-station archives anywhere. Records stretching back to the mid-1700s, so you can trace change across centuries, not just decades. Observations from every continent,...

items.title: Recalcitrant organic carbon dominates peat carbon storage but remains environmentally sensitive
items.title_en: Recalcitrant organic carbon dominates peat carbon storage but remains environmentally sensitive
items.title_zh: 难降解有机碳在泥炭碳储量中占主导地位，但仍对环境变化较为敏感
items.summary_en: Peatlands store vast amounts of organic carbon (OC), yet climate-induced water-table decline is increasingly threatening their long-term stability. Understanding the vertical heterogeneity of OC characteristics is crucial for predicting peat carbon dynamics in this context. However, estimates of this heterogeneity remain highly uncertain, as attention has focused mainly on total OC and vertical variations in OC composition remain poorly constrained. It masks shifts among OC components with contrasting decomposition potentials and environmental sensitivities. Here we investigated variations in peat OC components (labile, intermediate, recalcitrant OC; LOC, IOC, ROC) from three distinct depth intervals (i.e. 0–10 cm surface, 10–20 cm subsurface, and >20 cm deep) in peatlands across four regions of China. We found that OC components across all regions exhibited distinct vertical distribution patterns that diverged from total OC. Despite accounting for over 70% of total OC, ROC showed the strongest sensitivity to both biological (fungi: bacteria ratio) and non-biological (bulk density, P, and Al-oxides) properties. Increasing depth, synergized by regional climate, strengthened non-biological constraints while weakening microbial regulation, thereby reshaping the vertical distribution of OC components. In addition, Sphagnum peat supported higher OC concentrations across depth intervals, and was associated with more favorable biogeochemical properties (e.g. higher C:P and fungi: bacteria ratios). These findings show that distinguishing OC components refines mechanistic understanding of the peatland OC stability, thereby improving predictive ability of peatland OC source-sink functions under future climate change.
items.summary_zh: 泥炭地储存着巨量的有机碳（OC），但气候变化导致的水位下降正日益威胁着其长期稳定性。在此背景下，了解有机碳特性的垂直异质性对于预测泥炭碳动态至关重要。 然而，由于研究重点主要集中在总有机碳上，且有机碳组成的垂直变化仍缺乏充分约束，因此对这种异质性的估算仍存在高度不确定性。这种不确定性掩盖了具有不同分解潜能和环境敏感性的有机碳组分之间的变化。在此，我们研究了泥炭地中有机碳组分（易分解、中等分解、难分解有机碳； LOC、IOC、ROC）在垂直方向上的变化，采样点位于中国四个地区的泥炭地，分别来自三个不同的深度区间（即0–10厘米表层、10–20厘米亚表层和>20厘米深层）。 研究发现，所有区域的有机碳组分均呈现出与总有机碳不同的独特垂直分布模式。尽管占总有机碳的70%以上，难降解有机碳（ROC）对生物（真菌与细菌比例）和非生物（体积密度、磷及铝氧化物）性质的敏感性最为显著。 随着深度的增加，在区域气候的协同作用下，非生物约束因素增强，而微生物调控作用减弱，从而重塑了有机碳组分的垂直分布。 此外，泥炭藓泥炭在各个深度区间均具有更高的有机碳浓度，并具有更有利的生物地球化学特性（例如更高的碳磷比和真菌与细菌的比例）。 这些发现表明，区分有机碳组分有助于深化对泥炭地有机碳稳定性的机制理解，从而提高在未来气候变化背景下预测泥炭地有机碳源汇功能的能力。

items.title: Reduced summer carbon dioxide efflux from semi-arid agrivoltaic compared to conventional horticultural soil
items.title_en: Reduced summer carbon dioxide efflux from semi-arid agrivoltaic compared to conventional horticultural soil
items.title_zh: 与传统园艺土壤相比，半干旱地区农光互补系统的夏季二氧化碳排放量有所减少
items.summary_en: Agrivoltaic (AV) systems that combine horticultural crops with photovoltaic (PV) infrastructure on the same land parcel can provide mutual benefits for crop performance, electricity production, and water use in semi-arid climates. Whether semi-arid AV systems provide additional benefits for soil development and carbon (C) accumulation remains unclear. Larger aboveground biomass and yield production, which has been observed in semi-arid AV for certain crops, may accelerate C loss by supporting more continual and extensive microbial and root respiration, resulting in net zero or negative change in soil C over a growing season. Alternatively, AV systems may retain more soil C by reducing stress-induced respiration. To test these contrasting hypotheses, we compared crop biomass and yield, soil carbon pools, and semi-continuous microclimate and respired carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions for two horticultural crops grown in an experimental AV site in southern Arizona, USA. Over one summer growing season, we observed an approximately 9% reduction in daily mean soil CO2 efflux from legume (cowpea, Vigna unguiculata) and 48% reduction from aromatic herb (basil, Ocimum basilicum) beds, with the strongest impacts of AV appearing during the early monsoon season when plants were mature. On diel timescales, AV soil CO2 efflux peaked later in the day compared to conventional horticultural beds, corresponding to lagged increases in soil temperature under solar panels. Smaller CO2 efflux in AV coincided with a doubling of aboveground crop biomass. Both crops and cover types experienced similar declines in soil C over the growing season, indicating that reduced CO2 efflux did not correspond to a measurable increase in soil C during this period and highlighting the need to resolve other C transformation and loss pathways. Complementing its well-described food-water-energy benefits, we find potential for AV to reduce soil CO2 efflux and urge future research to identify changes to soil C cycling that result from the addition of PV to horticultural landscapes.
items.summary_zh: 农光（AV）系统将园艺作物与光伏（PV）基础设施结合在同一地块上，可在半干旱气候条件下为作物生长、发电和用水带来互利效益。但半干旱地区的农光系统是否能为土壤发育和碳（C）积累带来额外效益，目前尚不明确。 在半干旱地区，某些作物的农光系统已被观察到具有更高的地上部生物量和产量，这可能会通过促进更持续、更广泛的微生物和根系呼吸作用而加速碳损失，导致一个生长季内土壤碳的净变化为零或呈负值。 另一方面，AV系统也可能通过减少应激诱导的呼吸作用来保留更多的土壤碳。为了验证这些相互矛盾的假设，我们对比了在美国亚利桑那州南部一个实验性AV站点中种植的两种园艺作物的生物量和产量、土壤碳库，以及半连续微气候和二氧化碳（CO₂）排放量。 在一个夏季生长季内，我们观察到豆科作物 （牛豆，Vigna unguiculata）的日均土壤二氧化碳排放量减少了约9%，而芳香草本植物（罗勒，Ocimum basilicum）种植床的排放量则减少了48%，其中AV系统的影响在植物成熟的季风季节初期最为显著。 在昼夜时间尺度上，与传统园艺种植床相比，AV土壤二氧化碳释放量的峰值出现在一天中的较晚时段，这与太阳能电池板下土壤温度的滞后升高相吻合。 AV系统中较低的二氧化碳排放量恰与地上部作物生物量翻倍同时发生。在整个生长季节，无论是作物还是覆盖类型，土壤碳含量均呈现类似的下降趋势，这表明在此期间，二氧化碳排放量的减少并未对应土壤碳含量的可测量的增加，同时也突显了厘清其他碳转化和损失途径的必要性。 除了已广为人知的食物、水和能源方面的益处外，我们还发现AV在减少土壤二氧化碳释放方面具有潜力，并敦促未来的研究确定土壤碳含量的变化。

items.title: Increasing tropical forest fragmentation intensifies extreme high temperatures
items.title_en: Increasing tropical forest fragmentation intensifies extreme high temperatures
items.title_zh: 热带森林破碎化加剧导致极端高温现象加剧
items.summary_en: Deforestation, as one of the most pressing global environmental challenges, can intensify local temperature extremes through altering surface properties (e.g. albedo, roughness and evapotranspiration) and the associated land–atmosphere interactions. Prior studies have largely focused on the effects of forest cover changes at the grid scale, whereas the impact of subgrid-scale changes in forest fragmentation has received relatively limited attention. Utilizing satellite-based forest fragmentation index (FFI) data and the ERA5-Land reanalysis data, we investigate impacts of FFI changes in tropical forests on local extreme temperature indices, including the annual mean and maximum values of daily maximum temperature (TXm and TXx, respectively). Our results show that increasing FFI (i.e. forests becoming more fragmented) can significantly intensify extreme temperatures, with each unit increase in FFI corresponding to increases of 0.35 °C –1.14 °C for TXm and 0.83 °C –2.85 °C for TXx. These phenomena are mainly attributed to fragmentation-induced shifts in surface energy partitioning, which reduce latent heat flux and enhance sensible heating. The sensitivities of extreme temperatures to increasing FFI vary by region, with its strength being strongest in the Congo Basin (1.14 °C unit−1 for TXm and 2.85 °C unit−1 for TXx) but weaker in the Amazon basin (0.58 °C unit−1 for TXm and 1.21 °C unit−1 for TXx) and Southeast Asia (0.35 °C unit−1 for TXm and 0.83 °C unit−1 for TXx). These regional differences result from that background hydroclimatic conditions and land–atmosphere coupling strength can modulate the effect of forest fragmentation changes on extreme temperatures. These findings highlight the important role of increasing forest fragmentation in amplification of local temperature extremes, with implications for developing forest management strategies aimed at enhancing resilience to extreme climate events under ongoing warming.
items.summary_zh: 森林砍伐作为最紧迫的全球环境挑战之一，会通过改变地表特性（如反照率、粗糙度和蒸散量）以及相关的陆地-大气相互作用，加剧当地的极端气温。 先前的研究主要关注网格尺度上森林覆盖变化的影响，而亚网格尺度森林破碎化变化的影响则相对较少受到关注。 利用基于卫星的森林破碎化指数（FFI）数据和 ERA5-Land 再分析数据，我们研究了热带森林中 FFI 变化对当地极端温度指数的影响，包括日最高温度的年均值和最大值（分别表示为 TXm 和 TXx）。 研究结果表明，FFI的增加（即森林破碎化程度加深）会显著加剧极端温度，FFI每增加一个单位，TXm和TXx分别上升0.35 °C–1.14 °C和0.83 °C –2.85 °C。这些现象主要归因于森林破碎化导致的地表能量分配变化，这种变化会降低潜热通量并增强显热加热。 极端温度对 FFI 增加的敏感性因地区而异，其中刚果盆地最为显著（TXm 为 1.14 °C/单位，TXx 为 2.85 °C/单位），而亚马逊盆地 （TXm 为 0.58 °C/单位，TXx 为 1.21 °C/单位）以及东南亚（TXm 为 0.35 °C/单位，TXx 为 0.83 °C/单位）则较弱。 这些区域差异源于背景水文气候条件和陆地-大气耦合强度能够调节森林破碎化变化对极端温度的影响。这些发现凸显了森林破碎化加剧在放大局部温度极端事件中的重要作用，这对制定旨在增强在持续变暖背景下应对极端气候事件韧性的森林管理策略具有重要意义。

items.summary_en: The following is a summary of global temperature conditions in Berkeley Earth’s analysis of September 2026. September 2026 was nominally the 2nd warmest September on record, with a global average of 1.65 ± 0.11 °C (2.96 ± 0.19 °F) above the 1850–1900 average, behind only September 2023. Land temperatures averaged 2.17 ± 0.16 °C (3.90 ± 0.29 °F) above the 1850–1900 average, the 2nd warmest September for terrestrial regions. Ocean temperatures were 1.368 ± 0.068 °C (2.46 ± 0.12 °F) above the 1850–1900 average, a clear record for September and nominally the warmest month of any kind in the ocean record. El Niño has reached record strength on the conventional Niño 3.4 index, and its peak is still expected later this year. Roughly 11.5% of Earth’s surface experienced its warmest September on record, and 53 countries set national September records. Spain, Portugal, Andorra and Italy set national September records, extending an exceptional late summer in southwestern Europe. 2026 now has roughly a 96% chance of becoming the warmest year on record, up from about 93% a month ago. Global Summary According to Berkeley Earth’s high-resolution temperature dataset, September 2026 was the 2nd warmest September since records began in 1850, with a monthly global average of 1.65 ± 0.11 °C (2.96 ± 0.19 °F) above the 1850–1900 (pre-industrial) average. It sits about 0.06 °C below September 2023. The anomaly in September 2026 is nominally the third largest of any month, behind only September 2023 and August 2026. Global average temperature for the month of September in each year since 1850, relative to the 1850–1900 average. September 2026 sits just below September 2023 at the top of the record. On a month-to-month basis, September was nominally slightly cooler than August 2026 though within the margin or error. It remains sharply warmer than other months in 2026. September 2026 continued the run of months above the 1.5 °C mark that began in July, as the warming influence of El Niño has grown. Monthly global mean temperature since 1980, relative to the 1850–1900 average, with the long-term trend in red. Only one month of 2026 has set a record warm month (August 2026) with most months entering as the 2nd to 5th warmest. Depsite that, we have now pushed close to all-time record high temperature anomalies. Record and near-record warmth is expected to continue through the end of the year due to the short-term influence of a record-breaking El Niño. Global temperature anomaly by calendar month for every year since 1850. Over the most recent 12 months (October 2025 to September 2026), the global average was 1.458 ± 0.074 °C (2.62 ± 0.13 °F) above the 1850–1900 average, making it the 2nd warmest such 12-month period on record. It is behind the period ending in September 2024 and effectively tied with the period ending in September 2025, which it exceeds by only 0.003 °C. Because El Niño’s influence on the global mean lags its peak in the Pacific, this measure is expected to keep rising into 2027. 12-month moving average of global mean temperature with its 95% uncertainty range, plus a 30-year LOWESS smooth (red) indicating the long-term trend. Anomalies are relative to the 1850–1900 average. Spatial Variation In September 2026, warmer-than-average temperatures covered most of the globe. The warmth was most pronounced across the central and eastern equatorial Pacific, where El Niño appears as a broad warm band stretching east to the coast of South America, and across the high Arctic, including the Canadian Arctic Archipelago. Large positive anomalies also covered western and central Europe and the western Mediterranean, the western North Atlantic off North America, Australia, and much of northern and central Asia. Some of the largest anomalies anywhere were over West Antarctica. The most prominent cool anomaly was elsewhere on Antarctica, centered on the Weddell Sea sector and stretching along parts of the East Antarctic coast, with smaller cool areas over the Greenland ice sheet, along the west coast of the United States, and at the southern tip of South America. September 2026 surface temperature anomalies relative to the 1951–1980 average. The warm band across the equatorial Pacific reflects El Niño. Gray areas indicate regions with insufficient data this month. Roughly 11.5% of Earth’s surface experienced its locally warmest September on record (about 9.3% of land and 12.7% of ocean surfaces), and 80.3% of the surface was warmer than average. The largest contiguous region of record warmth occurred in the Eastern tropical Pacific, where a record-breaking El Niño event is underway. Record warmth also covered parts of the tropical and western North Atlantic including the Gulf of Mexico and the Caribbean, Iberia and the western Mediterranean, northwest Africa, the Sahel and the Horn of Africa, the Arabian Peninsula and the Persian Gulf, much of the Indian Ocean, maritime Southeast Asia, and parts of northern Russia and Kazakhstan....
items.summary_zh: 以下是伯克利地球（Berkeley Earth）对2026年9月全球气温状况的分析摘要。2026年9月名义上是有记录以来第二暖的9月，全球平均气温比1850–1900年的平均值高出1.65 ± 0.11 °C （2.96 ± 0.19 °F），仅次于2023年9月。 陆地气温平均比1850–1900年的平均值高出2.17 ± 0.16 °C（3.90 ± 0.29 °F），是陆地区域有记录以来第二暖的9月。 海洋温度较1850–1900年平均值高出1.368 ± 0.068 °C（2.46 ± 0.12 °F），这不仅是9月有史以来的最高纪录，从名义上讲也是海洋观测史上所有月份中温度最高的一个。 根据传统的尼诺3.4指数，厄尔尼诺现象已达到有记录以来的最强强度，预计其峰值仍将在今年晚些时候出现。地球表面约11.5%的区域经历了有记录以来最热的9月，53个国家创下了9月国家高温纪录。 西班牙、葡萄牙、安道尔和意大利均刷新了9月国家纪录，延续了西南欧这一非同寻常的夏末天气。2026年成为有记录以来最暖年份的概率目前约为96%，较一个月前的约93%有所上升。 全球概况 根据伯克利地球（Berkeley Earth）的高分辨率气温数据集，2026年9月是自1850年有记录以来第二暖的9月，全球月平均气温比1850–1900年（工业革命前）的平均值高出1.65 ± 0.11 °C （2.96 ± 0.19 °F），较1850–1900年（工业革命前）的平均值高出该数值。这一数值比2023年9月低约0.06 °C。 2026年9月的异常值名义上为历年各月中的第三高，仅次于2023年9月和2026年8月。自1850年以来各年9月的全球平均气温，相对于1850–1900年的平均值。 2026年9月的温度仅略低于2023年9月，并列历史最高纪录。从月与月之间的对比来看，9月的温度名义上略低于2026年8月，但仍在误差范围内。与2026年的其他月份相比，9月的温度仍然显著偏高。 2026年9月延续了自7月以来月均气温持续高于1.5 °C的趋势，这是由于厄尔尼诺现象的增温效应
